items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: And the guy that ran it was named Piney Brown (PHONETIC). I don't know if you've ever heard that name.

ctx.x: Well I guess you wouldn't remember really heard him play the first time and if he --

It was a jam. You know -- it was a jam. We used to go to a place down there in Kansas City and jam -- you know. Called The Subway. It was on 18th and Pine. And it's under a place -- under a restaurant named Eleanor's. And she had very good food there.
You know -- and it was under there -- a basement
